productionConstant: Locate the described checkbox, image tile or verify control with screenshot vision, move the top-page pointer, then send one trusted press and release. Before input the runtime checks the allowed page, recognized challenge frame, geometry, content and final hit; these checks can refuse the action. Drag, slider, audio and typed targets are unsupported. Page handlers may submit data or make network requests in response to the click.
gateSection: actionGateQuestions, actionRiskLimit, gateFailures and boundedObservation; start actionGateQuestions, end before GateVerdict
controllerPublicationChanges: Module/output/prior-artifact paths relocated only; not rerun.
